title: Grateful Dead Live at Newcastle-Under-Lyme on 1970-05-24
source: Unknown Board MR > Maxell XLII-S90 cassette (unknown generation) > Audacity via soundcard > Goldwave (to increase volume) > FLAC

ai_review.summary: Audience tape sounds better than a soundboard, impressive given old gear, but the Lovelight track is cut too short.
ai_review.review: The lone reviewer raves that this audience recording actually out‑shines typical board sources, praising the taper’s skill despite the period's poor equipment. The only criticism is that the Lovelight segment ends prematurely, but overall the audio quality is deemed excellent.

ai_rating.rationale: A single 5‑star review praises the recording highly; no musical performance details are given, so rating leans on audio quality alone.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and lively sound that 'beats the board'; good taper work despite vintage, poor equipment; track cut too short.
